messages:
rachel: opened a docs PR to add Sierra-30B (int8) to the model catalog + model card. includes a limits matrix, short migration checklist, perf notes, and SDK snippets for generation and embeddings. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5210
priya: nice—can you paste the perf numbers and hardware you used for the limits/bench section? want to be explicit in the table.
ethan: ran microbench on 2x a100-80g (data-parallel): p50 gen latency ~95ms for 1024 tokens (batch=2), sustained throughput ~220 tok/s (batch=16) for short sequences. Resident memory ~86GB with int8 (Q4) artifact. full csv: https://gist.github.com/ethan/sierra-30b-bench
skevin: (typo) -> kevin: quick nit: call out that those throughput numbers were with dynamic batching and prefix KV caching enabled; raw single-request perf is lower. add a small note in the benchmarks section.
mahmoud: link-checker flagged a relative link in the migration guide: `../models/sierra/overview.md` -> 404. switch to canonical `/models/sierra` or use the slug helper.
docs-bot: Link check failed: /docs/models/sierra -> 404
rachel: thanks, fixing to `/models/sierra` and adding a redirect for old permalinks in the PR.
priya: compatibility question: which runtimes can load the int8 blobs? last time we had layout changes across releases.
ethan: Sierra-30B-int8 uses KV layout v3. Runtimes <3.2 can't load the int8 artifact. We should add a compatibility row in the card and a short migration snippet showing how to force fp16 for parity testing.
kevin: suggested wording for the table row: `Runtime < 3.2 — int8 (KV v3) unsupported. Requests will be routed to Sierra-30B-fp16 automatically. Upgrade runtime to opt into int8.` short and explicit.
mahmoud: please also add a bullet under "known behavior diffs": small tokenization parity and output variance (~3-5%) when switching between fp16 and int8. recommend running a small eval set after migration.
rachel: will add both. also adding sequence guidance: `max sequence: 12288 (tested); recommend sustained <=6144 for stable P50` and mark hardware used for the max-seq runs.
priya: can we show example SDK calls for forcing fp16 and for batched streaming generation? paste snippets here and I'll drop them into the PR.
ethan: Python generation example (streaming, batched):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
prompts = ["Tell me a story.", "Summarize the doc."]
resp = client.generate.create(model="sierra-30b-int8", input=prompts, max_tokens=512, batch_size=2, stream=True)
for chunk in resp:  # streaming iterator
    print(chunk.text)
```
JS example for forcing fp16 (parity test):
```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
const resp = await client.generate.create({ model: 'sierra-30b-fp16', input: 'test parity', maxTokens: 32 })
console.log(resp.output)
```
mahmoud: embedding snippet (batched) for the card:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
texts = ['doc1', 'doc2', 'doc3']
emb = c.embeddings.create(model='sierra-30b-int8', input=texts, batch_size=8)
print([d.embedding for d in emb.data])
```
kevin: tiny doc nit: use consistent terminology `int8 (Q4)` everywhere instead of generic "quantized". also add a small note about model size on disk for the artifact (approx 42GB) so enterprise users can plan capacity.
priya: will add artifact-size row and a short bullet about rollout tips (canary on low-traffic routes, compare fp16 vs int8 evals).

rachel: perfect. tagging @sam @kevin for review. I'll merge after approvals and post a short note in #release-war-room once the card is live.
sam: LGTM, will review in the AM and approve if all checks are green :thumbsup:
